$comment: The identity area's alerts (spec 02 §18.2; spec 08 §7.8 group C), L-SAT-09's by the steward's rulings of 22 Nov: auth-endpoint-unlisted, then secret-unreadable, rate-limiter-failing, csrf-refused-jump, and the sign-in and step-up rates (sign-in-failing, second-factor-step-failing, step-up-failing, step-up-locked), each over a line the code writes where the realms run (console's developer realm, admin's staff realm; the origin gate and the endpoint allowlist on verify too). The API halves write auth.endpoint_blocked (verify with realm none); its query counts every line whose class is not blocked, so a line that lost its class counts as unlisted and the alert fails closed. sign-in-failing and second-factor-step-failing split auth.unhandled_error by authPath: the factor-step and enrolment paths are second-factor-step-failing's, every other value (a missing one included) sign-in-failing's, so no unhandled error is left out. One incident per service, the label held to the rule's sources: any other value, a missing one included, is the one label `other`. The rest of the area's alerts are owed in catalog/owed.ts, each with why.

alerts.name: auth-endpoint-unlisted
alerts.incident_cause: Requests for /api/auth/* paths the realm does not list, above their threshold in 15 minutes: a client or library change calling an unlisted path, or probing. Count: {{value}}.

metadata.check: The realm and release on the lines; the request lines with the same requestId and their cfRay; whether the count began with a release.

alerts.name: secret-unreadable
alerts.incident_cause: A stored secret (an authenticator key or backup codes) that no configured BETTER_AUTH_SECRETS version opens: the person cannot finish their factor step. Lines: {{value}}.

metadata.check: The realm and kind on auth.secret_unreadable; the BETTER_AUTH_SECRETS versions the service holds (names only) against the last rotation; the release.

alerts.name: rate-limiter-failing
alerts.incident_cause: The auth limiter could not read or write its store and failed closed: sign-ins and codes are refused with 503. Failures: {{value}}.

metadata.check: The bucket on limits.store_failed; database-unreachable and pool-exhausted for the same service; the database's own state.

alerts.name: csrf-refused-jump
alerts.incident_cause: The origin gate refused unsafe requests above its pre-deploy baseline in 15 minutes: the app's configured origin and what its pages send (Origin, Sec-Fetch-Site, X-Fin-App) drifted apart, or someone is sending requests from another site. Refusals: {{value}}.

metadata.check: The reason and route on csrf.refused; FIN_PUBLIC_ORIGIN on the service against the host its pages are served on; the X-Fin-App the client sends; whether the count began with a release.

alerts.name: sign-in-failing
alerts.incident_cause: The auth library answered 500 on a sign-in or session path (an error no refusal names): people may not be able to sign in. Errors: {{value}}.

metadata.check: The authPath and errorId on auth.unhandled_error, and the error.unexpected line with the same errorId in the service's Errors application; the last deploy.

alerts.name: second-factor-step-failing
alerts.incident_cause: The auth library answered 500 on a factor-step or enrolment path: people may not be able to finish their second factor or add one. Errors: {{value}}.

metadata.check: The authPath and errorId on auth.unhandled_error, and the error.unexpected line with the same errorId in the service's Errors application; the last deploy.

alerts.name: step-up-failing
alerts.incident_cause: Step-up intents refused because the request's fields did not match the intent's digest, above the threshold in 15 minutes: the client and the server bind different fields for an action. Refusals: {{value}}.

metadata.check: The realm and action on step_up.refused with reason digest; the route policy's bind list for that action against what the client sends; the last deploy of the pages and of the API half.

alerts.name: step-up-locked
alerts.incident_cause: Sessions ended by the fifth failed step-up, above the threshold in 15 minutes: someone may be guessing a factor in a stolen session. Locks: {{value}}.

metadata.check: The realm on step_up.locked; the people of those sessions, from the audit log's step_up.locked events and their requestIds.
